method.excluded_runs: 5 reversed-order ablation runs (used only in the ablation)
method.responsiveness: opening turn of each debate excluded; 'responsiveness_all' includes it
method.p_values: topic-stratified permutation test on debate means (10000 permutations)
method.confidence_intervals: topic-stratified cluster bootstrap over debates (2000 resamples)
method.multiple_comparisons: Holm: RQ1 across 7 dims (confirmatory); RQ2 across 28; others exploratory

summary.test: two-sided Mann-Whitney U on per-event change in the debate's round mean (next round minus trigger round); exact permutation p as a check
